referencedQA.proof: final author QA receipt and additional real temporary-file exclusivity/0600/durable-before-effect/no-reopen test inspected; not rerun or combined with independent count

closedFindings: The exact approved Netlify account/site is fixed before metadata use; malformed/null gate values fail closed.
Intake requires empty owner identity/draft proof and observed preflight revocation; unknown reads cannot substitute.
Initial existing-workspace responses and a mismatched run marker cannot bind the cancellation target.
Unexpected forbidden actions latch cleanup-only state with sanitized denial evidence; wrong-purpose/public-private response contracts are checked.
Live persistence is built-in immutable exclusive file storage at a deterministic phase-ID path; an existing phase ledger cannot be resumed or reset.

sourceAudit.reserveBeforeEffect: Counters and private attempt state are reserved and persisted before the caller transport; poisoned persistence prevents dispatch.
sourceAudit.unknownOutcome: Unknown mutations consume their attempt and halt new writes; known phase-session cleanup remains bounded. Unknown create stops with retained unresolved production state rather than blind replay.
sourceAudit.browserInterception: Actual route.fetch uses maxRedirects0/maxRetries0; the guard manually accounts allowed public GET hops and never replays API/mutation redirects. Final fulfillment removes Location. Service workers and WebSockets are blocked, contexts begin empty, and only known optional font requests are harmless blocked entries.
sourceAudit.secretMinimization: Ledger snapshots retain counters, fixed path/action/status/timing and sanitized reasons; volatile tokens/bearers, full bodies, private query values and provider environment payloads are excluded.
sourceAudit.realFilePersistence: The additional author case uses a temporary actual file, checks mode0600 and a reserved_unknown/counter row from disk inside the simulated transport, rejects reopening before and after finish, rejects a substitute live ledger path, verifies no owner email in file, then removes the temporary fixture.

fidelityLimits: Manual final-byte fulfillment keeps the browser address at the original Pretty URL; native canonical navigation/history behavior is not proved.
The author rehearsal uses exact b9 browser assets with current local memory handlers; it is not a real deployed signup/storage/mail/provider acceptance.
Reported loopback requests are from the separately executed QA fixture; this independent five-case test itself made zero physical requests.
The guard is verification infrastructure, not a production tenant cohort, automatic-billing or provider spending control.
The proposed hosted phase still requires explicit authority; all existing live phase budgets remain closed.
